title: Excluding-Australia cumulative tail shortfall
limitations: Tail measures are positive-part shortfalls applied to the event-versus-neutral revenue shortfall; they are not signed mean losses.
The excluding-Australia aggregate is a joint modeled aggregate quantile, not a sum of country quantiles.
Assessment is conditional on the official forecast vintage used at the assessment date and is not causally identified.
Scope is agriculture, forestry and fishing value added with conditional government revenue transmission, not total-economy loss.
